_readme: Ve's file: the model, turn cap, time limit, USD cap and daily cap of each kind of claude session (run-loop.ps1 starts one session per job). Edit by hand; the loop only reads it. Missing or empty values fall back to the defaults in gate-rules.ps1 ($SessionDefaults, $LoopOptionDefaults). A build uses build.smallModel when its issue carries one of build.smallLabels, else build.model. maxBudgetUsd is passed to claude as --max-budget-usd (0 = no cap); a build on a model that is not Opus uses build.smallMaxBudgetUsd. A session stopped by its USD cap mid-build is failure class max-budget (retried once, like max-turns). maxPerDay: at most this many sessions of the kind start per local day across all runs (0 = no cap; counts in <LOOP_HOME>\state\daily-sessions.json). options: proposeIssueDigest (the runner lists the issues once into the proposal header), compactPrompts (build-only LOOP.md blocks left out of proposal/review prompts), logKeepDays (prune old logs at run start; rundata.json and run-<id>.log kept; 0 = never), digestMaxIssues, digestDeployedDays. intake: the session that plans one of your loop:request issues (your requests' sessions are not counted against the build/propose daily caps; intake has its own maxPerDay). memory: the tool-less Haiku memory agent (its JSON is validated by the runner). options.productStore (decision collector, D:\hub\state\product\cardlens), options.memoryAgent (preferences; needs productStore) and options.requestIntake (your loop:request issues) switch Phase 1 on; productCollectMinutes, memoryMinDecisions, memoryEveryDays tune them. options.designSkills lets build, proposal and review sessions use the pinned design aids under D:\loop-tools (impeccable engine: context / shot / detect; ui-ux-pro-max search.py) and adds LOOP.md section 9; the runner re-hashes the engine every run and turns the feature off on a mismatch (the taste skill is never available to the loop). run-loop.ps1 -Model / -MaxTurns override every session for one run (-Model never applies to memory). Phase 2: options.observerPm (needs productStore) splits Phase B into observe (the Observer: runs only when a file of a workflow in innovation/workflows.json changed since the last observation, or a 7-day metrics rate moved by observeMetricPoints percentage points; read-only, findings JSON validated by the runner) and pm (the product manager, in place of propose: runs only when there are new findings, decisions, research or slices since its last run AND a proposal slot is free; every issue it opens cites a finding or decision). Idle days start neither. With observerPm off, propose runs as before. Phase 3: options.qaUx (needs productStore) runs a qa session after each deployed build or shipped request child (in the same run once the deploy is verified, else on the next run; skipped with no session when the merge touched only tests, docs or innovation\): it checks the build's acceptance criteria (the Plan comment's loop-criteria block, else the proposal's How it would be tested) on the LIVE site, read-only, and the runner writes the verdict to qa.jsonl and failures as findings for the PM. A ux session reviews a deploy that changed the UI, plus a weekly sample (uxSampleDays) of one workflow not reviewed for uxStaleDays; its findings carry a measurable recommendation. Order: builds, QA, UX, then the Observer and the PM. QA never rolls back.
